text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-we finally meet again, my rebel... Ah!
I-I mean,
rival!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh... I'm so, so, so sorry! I screwed
up my
lines!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can't even read a script right. I'm sorry
I'm so
worthless, and stupid, and... and...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The rhythm of your speech... You were
born to
play a minstrel! Yes, that's it! I'm
changing your
role!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You are now a humble minstrel seeking
an
audience with me, the king... or so
you claim!
You're actually there to kill
me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us continue! Perform your next
lines with
an apologetic flair!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Your Majesty, but your life
ends here.
D-d-d-die by my blade,
pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I find your pain so exquisite!
Please
forgive me for sending you to the
depths of
Hades!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaa-ha-ha-ha-ha! Yes, yes, YES! The

juxtaposition of madness and comedy is
truly
magnificent!
